title: JavaSchoolLab - Overview: traffic, latency, errors
description: How many requests arrive, how long they take, how many fail, and what the business operations (sign-up, login, quiz, certificate) are doing. Pick endpoints with the "Endpoint" filter.

panels.title: Application
panels.description: 1 = Prometheus can scrape the application, 0 = it cannot.

panels.title: Requests / second
panels.description: All HTTP requests handled by the application (the Endpoint filter applies).

panels.title: Server errors (5xx)
panels.description: Share of requests that failed with an HTTP 5xx server error.

panels.title: Client errors (4xx)
panels.description: Share of requests answered with HTTP 4xx (bad input, not found, not logged in). Normally not a fault of the server.

panels.title: Latency p95
panels.description: 95% of requests are answered faster than this.

panels.title: Latency p99
panels.description: 99% of requests are answered faster than this.

panels.title: Requests in flight
panels.description: Requests being processed at this moment.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the application started.

panels.title: Traffic: how many requests are coming in
Requests per second by outcome
panels.description: SUCCESS = 2xx, REDIRECTION = 3xx, CLIENT_ERROR = 4xx, SERVER_ERROR = 5xx.

panels.title: Requests per second by HTTP status
Requests in the selected time range
panels.description: Total number of requests between the start and the end of the time range at the top right.

panels.title: Response time percentiles
panels.description: p95 = 95% of requests were faster than this line.

panels.title: Response time distribution
panels.description: Each column is a moment in time, each row a response-time band, the colour how many requests fell in it.

panels.title: Share of requests answered within 300 ms
panels.description: A "fast enough" view: the closer to 100% the better.

panels.title: Server errors (5xx) per second by endpoint
panels.description: A fault of the server. Should stay at zero.

panels.title: Client errors (4xx) per second by endpoint
panels.description: 401 = not logged in, 403 = not allowed, 404 = not found, 429 = rate limited.

panels.title: Log lines by level (per second)
panels.description: A rising ERROR line is the first sign of trouble. Open the Logs & Traces dashboard to read them.

panels.title: Failing endpoints (5xx and 4xx in the selected range)
Business operations (every *Service method, measured by ServiceObservationAspect)
Sign-ups
panels.description: Accounts created in the selected time range.

panels.title: Failed logins
panels.description: Wrong password, unknown user or bad code.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (service, method) (rate(jsl_service_seconds_sum{application="javaschoollab"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (service, method) (rate(jsl_service_seconds_count{application="javaschoollab"}[$__rate_interval])))
topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, method) (rate(jsl_service_seconds_bucket{application="javaschoollab"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Business operation failures per second (rejected or errored)
panels.description: Includes rules that reject bad input (for example a wrong password), not only crashes.

panels.title: Database pool in use
panels.description: Share of MySQL connections currently busy. Near 100% means requests queue for a connection.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of cache lookups that found the answer. Empty until the first cached call.

panels.title: Search index
panels.description: Server-side search (OpenSearch). The site still works without it.
